label: Run Rust crate here
args: printf "__ZED_TASK_START__\n"; dir="$ZED_DIRNAME"; while [ ! -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ] && [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done; printf "crate_dir=%s\n" "$dir"; if [ ! -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ]; then echo "Cargo.toml not found above $ZED_FILE"; exit 1; fi; cd "$dir" && cargo run
